name: ASH Report 分析诊断
description: ASH Report 基于 V$ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY 数据生成特定时间范围的性能分析报告。提供 Top Events、Top SQL、Top Sessions、Activity Over Time 等多维分析。适合诊断短暂的性能尖峰。

skip_when.desc: 性能问题已通过 AWR 定位

root_causes.name: 短暂性能尖峰未被 AWR 捕获
root_causes.desc: AWR 快照间隔（通常 1 小时）可能错过几分钟的性能尖峰。ASH 每秒采样可以捕获。

root_causes.name: ASH 数据解读不当
root_causes.desc: ASH 是采样数据，采样率不等于实际等待时间。需理解采样方法论。

root_causes.name: ASH 内存不足被覆盖
root_causes.desc: V$ASH 是内存环形缓冲区，高负载时数据很快被覆盖。需从 DBA_HIST_ACTIVE_SESS_HISTORY 查看历史。

root_causes.name: 未使用正确的时间范围
root_causes.desc: ASH Report 时间范围太大稀释了问题，或太小遗漏了上下文。

oltp.desc: OLTP 关注 Top SQL 和等待事件变化

olap.desc: OLAP 关注 Activity Over Time 和并行度

step2_top_events_ash.desc: ASH Top Events（最近 30 分钟）
step2_top_events_ash.sql: SELECT NVL(event, 'ON CPU') event, COUNT(*) samples, ROUND(COUNT(*)*100/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) pct FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE GROUP BY event ORDER BY samples DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step3_top_sql_ash.sql: SELECT sql_id, COUNT(*) samples, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) sessions, ROUND(COUNT(*)*100/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) pct FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE AND sql_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sql_id ORDER BY samples DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step4_activity_over_time.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'HH24:MI') ts, COUNT(*) active_sessions, SUM(CASE WHEN event IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) on_cpu, SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'User I/O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) io_wait FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'HH24:MI') ORDER BY ts
